description: Impressing a pattern into a gilt edge with heated finishing tools while the leaves are screwed tight in the press. A second colour of gold may be laid over the first and tooled through, leaving the design standing in the new gold.
name: gauffering

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter X, p.139. Internet Archive.
